title: History of the Frontier Areas Bordering on Assam from 1883-1941
title_english: History of the Frontier Areas Bordering on Assam from 1883-1941
title_tai: ပိုၼ်း လႅၼ်လိၼ် ဢႃႇသၢမ် လႄႈ တႆး ပတ်ႉၵၢႆး
author: Sir Robert Reid, K.C.S.I., K.C.I.E. (Governor of Assam)
genre: Administrative Monograph / Frontier History / Archival Survey
category: Assam Government Press Historical Record Series
provenance: Shillong: Assam Government Press / Internet Archive (historyofthefron035444mbp)
description: Authoritative administrative and political history of the frontier territories bordering Assam from 1883 to 1941, compiled by Governor Sir Robert Reid from confidential secretariat records. Contains exhaustive archival documentation on the Sadiya Frontier Tract, the Patkai routes, the Tai Khamti, Singpho, Tai Phake, and Tai Khamyang (Nora) communities, and trans-border diplomatic expeditions to Mogaung and the Upper Hukawng valley.
